categories.main_business_segments: China Education Group Holdings Limited primarily operates in vocational education services, offering a wide range of educational programs including higher vocational education, secondary vocational education, bachelor’s degree programs, master’s programs, diploma, and continuing education. The Group’s operations are segmented into domestic (Mainland China) and international markets (notably Australia and the UK).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group integrates advanced educational technologies such as AI in education and digital transformation initiatives. It emphasizes the development of dual-qualified teaching workforce, open regional academia-industry practice centers, and smart classrooms and laboratories to enhance teaching quality and innovation. The education management system is ISO-9001 certified, reflecting standardized quality assurance processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are students enrolling in vocational and higher education programs, including full-time students in China and international students in Australia and the UK. The Group serves the education sector with a focus on employment-oriented curricula to meet industry demands, targeting emerging industries and regional economies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant presence in key economic regions such as the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle, Bohai Rim Economic Zone, and Hainan Free Trade Zone. It also has operations in Australia and the United Kingdom.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Education Group Holdings Limited operates downstream in the education supply chain, directly providing educational services and managing educational institutions. It acts as an education service provider rather than upstream suppliers or intermediaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus includes aligning with national education policies to promote high-quality vocational education, deepening integration of industry and education, and accelerating AI and digital transformation in education. It prioritizes innovation in curriculum development, faculty capability enhancement, and research-education synergy with national-level research projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through tuition fees and boarding fees from students, supplemented by ancillary services such as on-campus management and vendor services. The Group also receives government grants and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group faces competition from other vocational and higher education providers in China, including public institutions expanding capacity. It maintains a leading position by focusing on employment-oriented education, innovation, and regional expansion but faces pricing pressure and market share challenges due to industry consolidation and policy changes.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended August 2025, the Group reported revenue of RMB7,363 million, representing an 11.9% year-on-year increase, with a net profit of RMB506 million. The total student enrollment was approximately 303,000, with steady growth in higher education enrollment. The Group’s total assets were RMB31,459 million, with a debt-to-asset ratio of 26.0%, reflecting a large-scale and financially stable education provider with ongoing capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group differentiates itself by offering employment-oriented, high-quality vocational education aligned with national policies and industry needs. It emphasizes innovation through AI integration, practical teaching excellence demonstrated by competition awards, and a comprehensive education management system. Its strategic regional presence and strong industry-education integration provide unique value to students and stakeholders.
